1. OpenAI Cookbook: Learn to work with LLM APIs
Repository: openai/openai-cookbook (https://github.com/openai/openai-cookbook?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner to Intermediate
The OpenAI Cookbook contains code examples and guides for working with the OpenAI API.

2. Claude Cookbooks: Explore another model integration
Repository: anthropics/claude-cookbooks (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-cookbooks?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner to Intermediate
Claude Cookbooks contains notebooks and recipes demonstrating ways to use Claude.

3. Awesome LLM Apps: Build complete applications with RAG
Repository: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps (https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner to Advanced, depending on the example
This collection contains open-source LLM applications, RAG implementations, AI agents, multi-agent projects, and MCP integrations.

4. Hugging Face Agents Course: Learn tools and agent fundamentals

The Hugging Face Agents Course is a structured course that progresses from agent fundamentals to agent frameworks and practical assignments.

5. GenAI Agents: Explore agent architectures and multi-agent systems

6. AI Project Gallery: Learn from applied AI projects

7. System Prompts Leaks: Study prompt patterns and security risks
